title: Signal Hardware Topology Diagnostics Demo

launch.notes: Runs the existing local and server host binaries, captures their current hardware-facing summary fields, and emits a rendered operator companion without redesigning host output.

scenarios.title: Native And Simulated Hardware Diagnostics Bootstrap
scenarios.summary: Captures native CoreAudio posture from the local host and simulated Linux backend posture from the server host through their existing summary lines.

evidence.notes: This hardware surface stays inside the current host binaries and records their existing device supervision, backend, endpoint, and external-I/O truth while adding a rendered operator companion.

known_exclusions: Plugin capability browsing remains deferred to a later g09.012 planning decision.
The simulated Linux backend side comes from signal-host-server summary output and does not claim native Linux device ownership.
This demo does not redesign host binary output or add a hardware control surface.
expected_checks: The local host reports native CoreAudio backend and output endpoint posture.
The server host reports simulated Linux backend session posture and explicit external-I/O/device-supervision truth.
The receipt keeps native-versus-simulated differences explicit instead of flattening them.
The rendered companion view makes native-versus-simulated posture visually inspectable without reading the raw receipt first.
signal-hardware only moves to live coverage because this manifest and receipt exist.
